# Mindset Lab

> A public log of experiments in mindset, physical endurance, and operational discipline by Kalen Michael. Real frameworks, zero wishy-washy fluff.

## Core Pillars
- **RAW:** Unfiltered notes on career rebuilding, identity shifts, and navigating high-stakes transitions.
- **LAB:** Active experiments in mental models, discipline systems, and human performance.
- **TOOLKIT:** Practical execution frameworks, routines, and physical endurance data (e.g., marathon blocks).

## Featured Notes & Substack Archive
- [The Sleep Reset Protocol](https://kalenmichael.substack.com/p/can-you-fix-your-broken-sleep-in): A 7-day field experiment testing morning sunlight, habit-stacking, and early walks to hard-reset a broken sleep schedule. (2026-08-20)
- [The Bot-Ridden Truth of Instagram Boost](https://kalenmichael.substack.com/p/the-bot-ridden-truth-of-instagram): An unvarnished look at what happens when paid ads backfire, how a custom analytics audit uncovered a 20% bot army, and the brutal reality of cleaning house. (2026-08-29)
- [Full Archive on Substack](https://kalenmichael.substack.com): Read all dispatches and notes.

## Vault & Tools
- [The Weekly Retro](https://kalenmichael.gumroad.com/l/weekly-retro): A 5-page system for building, tracking, and iterating your routine.
- [Operations Log](https://log.kalenmichael.com): A local execution dashboard for running, tracking, and iterating your weekly routines.
